title: Continuity of the Gaussian quantile
statement: Let $Q(\alpha)=\inf\{t\in\mathbb R:\alpha\le\Phi(t)\}$, where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian distribution function. For every $a\in(0,1)$, the function $Q$ is continuous at $a$.
hypotheses_covered: a belongs to the open interval (0,1)
replaced: Let $\Phi$ and $\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and put $Q=\Phi^{-1}$ and $I(p)=\varphi(Q(p))$ for $0<p<1$. For every $a\in(0,1)$, $Q$ is continuous at $a$.
